learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.

observations.text: No-history preview banner confirmed; trust5/5 ignored. Predicted All meet in one woman; locked.
Back10:11 lines. Back to one line animated through52 generations/3 lines, then99/1 line. Run1,000 families: all met, mean96. 25 and100 women: mean46 and197; reveal unlocked.

Joined lines never split; finite50 leads to one. 99 generations versus96 average; double women roughly doubles wait, about2N. She was not alone:49 other women lived beside her. Inline screenshot shows joining tree/histogram and text right-edge clipping; no saved screenshot.
